# data

Research outputs, manifests, reports, and model catalog artifacts.

## Purpose

- CIP daily/manifests/reports, research logs, benchmark sources, provider watch data.
- Model catalog changes and community consensus.

## Ownership

- Generated by scripts and CIP pipeline.
- Treated as durable record of routing research.

## Local Contracts

- JSON manifests are source of truth for provider/model changes.
- CSV files are append-only logs unless otherwise documented.

## Work Guidance

- Do not manually mutate without updating the generating script or task record.
- Redact any secrets that leak into research outputs.

## Verification

- Validate JSON schema with `scripts/crx-validate.mts` when applicable.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
